resources.string: Helping kids and grown-ups understand each other.
A LITTLE ROBOT. A LITTLE UNDERSTANDING.
Our first language. More room to grow.
What would you like to understand?
Explain slang and kid expressions in clear, everyday words.
Explain grown-up words in simple, friendly language.
What would you like to translate?
Review your words, then tap Translate.
Type a word, phrase, or sentence here…
A full sentence can help me understand what you mean.
Use example phrases. Don’t include private details.
The 1,000-character limit is reached. Review the end of your message.
Your robot is working on it…
Edit your words above, then try again.
This phrase needs live AI. Try a sample phrase for now.
Live translation sends your words to our service and its AI provider. AI can misunderstand expressions.
Your text will be sent to the translation service and its AI provider. Their data policies apply. Use example phrases without private details. AI can misunderstand expressions.
AI can misunderstand expressions. Check the meaning together.
We couldn’t reach the translation service. Check your connection and try again.
That took too long. Your words are still here. Try again.
The service is busy. Wait a minute, then try again.
Live translation isn’t available right now. Please try again later.
We didn’t get a clear translation. Please try again.
We couldn’t explain that safely. Try a different example phrase.
Something went wrong. Your words are still here. Please try again.

On-device recognition isn’t available here. Your phone’s speech service may send audio to its provider to recognize your words. Its privacy and retention policies apply. This app doesn’t save recordings. You can always type instead.
Your speech service may process audio remotely.
Microphone access wasn’t allowed. Tap the mic to try again, or type your words.
Microphone access is off. You can enable it in app settings, or keep typing.
Speech recognition isn’t available on this device. You can still type.
We didn’t catch any words. Tap the mic to try again, or type.
The speech service couldn’t connect. Try again, or type your words.
Speech recognition stopped. You can try again or keep typing.
English speech recognition isn’t ready on this device. Check your speech language settings, or type.
The microphone is busy. Wait a moment and try again, or type.
I forgot to study for the test. I’m cooked.
We need to prioritize our homework.
I didn’t prepare, and I think I’m going to have trouble on the test.
Here, “cooked” means expecting trouble, not preparing food.
You did an excellent job with that dance.
We need to find a choice that works for both of us.
Each person may need to give up a little of what they want.
Let’s wait and come back to that later.
We need to do our homework before less important things.
What happened before you said “I’m cooked” — a difficult situation, or something tiring?
